newsitem.title: TURKEY: Explosion on Turkish oil tanker, three feared dead.
newsitem.headline: Explosion on Turkish oil tanker, three feared dead.

text.p: Three people were believed dead in an explosion which damaged a large Turkish oil tanker in waters off the coast near Istanbul on Wednesday, the state-run Anatolian news agency reported.
The agency said the blast occurred in an empty fuel tank. Witnesses said three people in the tank at the time were feared dead.
Anatolian said the 155,000-tonne tanker Gole was anchored near a shipyard at Tuzla, south of Istanbul in the Marmara Sea, where it had been taken for maintenance.
The Gole was the first tanker to transport Iraqi oil from a port in southeast Turkey last December under the United Nations oil-for-food deal.
